settings.hero_title: You know who this is for.
settings.hero_body: Give them the complete collection: all 32 enamel badges from Kanto through Sinnoh, in four display boxes they can open and look through.
settings.hero_alt: Over-the-shoulder view of a recipient holding an open Kanto badge box, with the Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh boxes on a nearby table
settings.disclaimer: 32 enamel pins and four display boxes included. This is a styled opening scene; furniture is not included.
settings.story_title: A gift they can spend some time with.
settings.story_body: There are four boxes to open and 32 familiar little designs to look through. You’re giving them a complete collection they can display together or take individual pins from to wear.
settings.point_one_body: Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh are included in the gift.
settings.point_two_body: Each regional set arrives together in its own box.
settings.point_three_body: U.S. shipping is free. Typical arrival is 5–7 business days.
settings.proof_title: See the presentation before you give it.
settings.proof_body: Customer photos show the regional boxes open, with the individual enamel badges inside.
settings.decision_title: Their whole collection comes in one pack.
settings.decision_body: The order includes all 32 enamel pins and all four display boxes. Gift wrap and furniture are not included.
settings.final_body: All 32 enamel badges and four display boxes. Free U.S. shipping; typically arrives in 5–7 business days.
